🛠️ Data Engineering isn’t just ETL. It’s Engineering at Scale.
Every byte flowing through your pipeline has a cost — in compute, in time, and in business value.
Here’s what makes a solid Data Engineer in 2025:
✅ Understand data modeling: Star, Snowflake, and Lakehouse
✅ Know when to use batch vs stream processing
✅ Write efficient SQL, not just working SQL
✅ Master orchestration tools like Airflow/Dagster
✅ Optimize pipelines for cost, latency, and reliability
✅ Treat your pipelines like software — with CI/CD, tests, and logging
✅ Think in systems: What happens if Kafka goes down? Or a DAG fails?
📌 Tools change. Principles stay.
If you're learning Data Engineering — don’t just learn “how” — learn why.
Do follow Naresh Reddy Kotha for more!
